name: momentum_ignition_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY consolidates for 15-20 minutes within a 20-40 spot point range, intraday bracket-order traders and mean-reversion algos accumulate positions near both boundaries with stops clustered just outside. A breakout bar with 2.5x+ volume surge vs the preceding 5-minute baseline signals large institutional order flow overwhelming the range ceiling or floor. This triggers sequential stop-loss cascades from trapped traders in the next 30-90 seconds, pushing NIFTY an additional 20-35 spot points beyond the breakout level. At 5-second resolution we enter on the ignition bar itself — before most momentum algos have confirmed and joined — capturing the first 15-20 spot points of the cascade.

indicators.name: range_high_240
indicators.purpose: 20-minute rolling range ceiling. Original used 30 1-min bars = 30 min; we use 20 min (240 x 5s) because NIFTY's higher liquidity means stop clusters build faster than on single stocks — 15-20 minutes of consolidation is sufficient for meaningful clustered stops. Our hold is 30-90s (not 10-30 min), so we trade the faster version of the same ignition.

indicators.name: range_low_240
indicators.purpose: 20-minute rolling range floor, symmetric with range_high_240.

indicators.name: range_width_pct
indicators.purpose: Range width as % of index level. NIFTY filter: 0.10%-0.40% (roughly 24-96 spot pts at NIFTY 24000). Below 0.10% the range is noise/tick-size artifact; above 0.40% risk per trade exceeds what 90-second hold can recover from a failed breakout.

indicators.name: vol_avg_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute rolling volume baseline. Original used 20 1-min bars = 20 min; we use 60 x 5s = 5 min because NIFTY intraday volume patterns shift at hourly intervals and a 20-min baseline would be suppressed by low-volume early-morning candles, creating false surge signals. 5-min baseline captures the current activity regime.

indicators.name: vol_surge
indicators.purpose: Surge ratio. Threshold 2.5x (vs original 3.0x for stocks) because NIFTY volume is aggregated across many components — true institutional ignition appears at slightly lower multiples than single-stock breakouts.

indicators.name: close_position_in_bar
indicators.purpose: Where close sits within the current bar's range. Bull confirmation: >=0.70 (top 30% of bar). Bear confirmation: <=0.30 (bottom 30%). Filters 5-second spikes that briefly penetrate range but close back inside — genuine ignition bars close emphatically in the breakout direction.

buy_ce.confirmation: Close must exceed the previous bar's 20-min range high (not current bar's, to avoid lookahead)

buy_pe.confirmation: Close must break below the previous bar's 20-min range low

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option pts = ~10 spot points at delta 0.5. NIFTY false breakouts typically retrace 8-15 spot pts back inside the range within 30 seconds; 5 pts catches failed ignitions while tolerating normal breakout volatility. Tighter than 5 pts would be stopped by single-tick noise on the index.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option pts = ~16 spot points at delta 0.5. Successful NIFTY momentum ignitions extend 20-35 spot pts beyond range in 30-90s; targeting 16 spot pts captures 50-65% of the expected extension at 1:1.6 risk-reward without overstaying into momentum exhaustion.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 15:15 IST — stop new entries at 15:15, no time stop exits create positions after 15:20

filters.vix_filter: 12 < VIX < 22 — below 12 NIFTY range-bound all day (no breakouts), above 22 breakouts are gappy and slippage is higher even on limit orders
filters.time_filter: entries only 09:25-15:15 IST — skip first 10 minutes of high-volatility open noise where range has not yet formed
filters.volume_filter: vol_surge > 2.5 is the core entry condition
filters.trend_filter: no additional trend filter — strategy is directionally neutral, purely breakout-based
filters.spread_filter: not required — limit order execution eliminates spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — breakout pattern is well-known and crowding risk from other algos could front-run the cascade. However, at 5s entry we are among the fastest; slower 1-min or 5-min breakout systems enter after us.

adaptation_notes: Original operated on a universe of top 30 FnO stocks at 1-min bars, holding 10-30 min. Key changes: (1) single liquid index instead of stock universe eliminates stock-selection noise; (2) range lookback compressed from 30 min to 20 min because NIFTY stop clusters form faster than single stocks due to higher liquidity; (3) volume surge threshold lowered from 3.0x to 2.5x because index volume aggregates many components; (4) hold time compressed from 10-30 min to 30-90s — we trade only the initial stop-cascade portion of the move, exiting before the secondary momentum traders enter. Stop/target calibrated to 30-90s NIFTY option move sizes, not the original stock-level risk sizing.
weaknesses: 20-minute range may not have formed early in the session — strategy is inactive first ~20 min of each day
NIFTY index volume is a noisy proxy for order-flow intensity; a high vol_surge can reflect index rebalancing rather than directional conviction
False breakouts are frequent (~54% lose) — profitability requires the 1:1.6 R:R to hold, which depends on stop placement being respected
Stop cascades are shorter-lived on a liquid index than on single stocks — the full 20-35 pt extension does not always materialize in 90 seconds
